turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
Yes. A damaged item is handled as a product or delivery issue, not as a normal change-of-mind return.

Please send clear photos or a video showing the damage, along with your order reference and a description of the issue. Report it within 5 calendar days of delivery so the situation can be assessed. Please do not send the item back through the standard return process before reporting the damage.

turns.q: Will I get a replacement or a refund?
turns.replyTail:
A replacement or refund is not automatic. The damage must first be reviewed using clear photos or a video, your order reference and a description of the issue. The appropriate solution will then be determined for your case.

Please submit these details within 5 calendar days of delivery through the contact form on the Tediber website: https://www.tediber.com/. Do not send the item back before receiving further instructions.

turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail:
If more than one item is damaged, include every affected item in your report. Send clear photos or a video of each item, with a short description identifying the damage on each one, plus your order reference.

Submit these details within 5 calendar days of delivery through the contact form on the Tediber website: https://www.tediber.com/. Keep the items and their packaging, and do not send anything back before receiving further instructions.
